en-UK.name: P1 Recall Service
en-UK.description: Self-driven memory recall as an independent pluggable Python service.
en-UK.description_markdown: **P1 Recall Service** — self-driven memory recall pipeline running as an independent Python process. The shell is a thin HTTP relay: the service starts, tests and runs entirely without the host. Unplug the service and the host degrades gracefully.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: P1 召回服务
zh-CN.description: 自驱动记忆召回，独立可插拔 Python 服务
zh-CN.description_markdown: **P1 召回服务** — 自驱动记忆召回管线，以独立 Python 进程运行。本 shell 只是薄 HTTP 传导层：服务可完全脱离本体单独启动、测试、运行；拔掉服务本体优雅降级。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
